identity.name: Gables Estates
identity.notes: Exclusive, guard-gated waterfront community in Coral Gables, FL 33156 (Miami-Dade County), developed in the early 1960s by Arthur Vining Davis (ALCOA founder). Encompasses over 200 acres of Biscayne Bay shoreline with 192 single-family lots (166 waterfront), featuring deep-water sea-walled canals with direct, bridge-free access to Biscayne Bay engineered for mega-yacht berthing. Widely regarded as one of America's most prestigious and expensive residential neighborhoods, with entry prices starting at $10M+. Mandatory membership in Gables Estates Club, Inc. is a prerequisite for all property purchases, requiring sponsorship from existing residents and a non-refundable six-figure application fee. The association manages membership approvals, enforces covenants, and oversees common area maintenance and 24/7 security.

fees.note: Reported annual HOA dues covering security and common area maintenance. Not officially confirmed on HOA official sources; exact current figures not publicly verified. Transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments unavailable in public sources. Third-party aggregator; confidence reduced accordingly.

Non-refundable membership application fee (approx. $100,000 for U.S. residents; approx. $105,000 for foreign nationals) required prior to purchase approval. Sponsorship from existing residents also required. Corroborated by gablesestatesfl.com as a 'non-refundable six-figure application fee.'

Low end of monthly condo fee range ($824-$1,610). Includes common area maintenance, grounds maintenance, building maintenance, roof repair/replacement, community pool, security with 24-hour guard, property insurance, water, electric, trash removal, sewer, pest control, cable TV & internet, climate control, parking, recreation facilities. Exact fee varies by unit per listing pages. Data as of October 2026 per page. Retrieved 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z (approximate). Confidence 0.85.
High end of monthly condo fee range ($824-$1,610); varies by unit. Data as of October 2026 per page. Retrieved 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z (approximate). Confidence 0.85.

Club membership at Gables Estates Club is required before a property purchase can close; no fee amount stated on the page (source: Gables Estates Club as cited). No HOA/CDD fee figures given for this community on this page. Coral Gables metro context: median sale price for single-family homes $2.35M (Miami Realtors Q2 2025). Zillow Gables Estates Home Value Index typical value $21,601,582 as of Feb 28, 2026 (valuation, not a fee). Retrieved 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z; confidence 0.8.

amenities.detail: Round-the-clock security staffing at the guard-gated community entrance. Sourced from gablesestatesfl.com technical data sheet.
Community is exclusively guard-gated; all vehicles and visitors controlled at entry. Confirmed on official HOA site and multiple other sources.
Wide, deep, sea-walled canals winding through the community, engineered for large-yacht turns and mega-yacht berthing (vessels 100+ ft). 166 of 192 lots are directly waterfront on canals or bayfront.

Direct, unrestricted, bridge-free water access to open Biscayne Bay; no height clearance required for masts, flybridges, or superstructures of any specification. Bay access time approximately 5 minutes from private dock.
Most waterfront homes include private deepwater docks. Bulkheads and riparian rights vary by lot.
Community pool included in condo fees
Listed among the main gated waterfront communities in the southern Coral Gables corridor; strong emphasis on privacy. Retrieved 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z; confidence 0.75.

Community spans more than 200 acres of shoreline and includes 192 lots; wide, deep-water, seawalled canals (per Gables Estates Club and official community profile). Retrieved 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z; confidence 0.8.
Gables Estates Club; club membership is required before a property purchase can close, per the official club. Retrieved 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z; confidence 0.8.
Public listing examples indicate parcels ranging from about 38,762 square feet to 108,900 square feet; homes read as custom compounds. Retrieved 2026-02-28T00:00:00Z; confidence 0.7.
